step.name: Bag check
step.what_happens: An officer opens the bag on the table, checks it by hand and by eye, and removes the caps from plastic bottles.
slow_when: The bag is full or has many pockets.
The visitor carries merchandise or a power bank with cables.

exceptions.what: A prohibited item is found and the visitor drops it in the amnesty bin.
A prohibited item is found and the visitor wants to keep it.
The bag is larger than A4.
